notes.title: Update 0.3
notes.content:
A new game mode "Meat Grinder" has been added, as well as a new vehicle - the M1A2C tank.
Bugs and errors were also fixed. The vehicle now has team markings instead of widgets.
Hope you like the update)

Download the game:
Google Play (Android): https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.MemoryShards.BFBMS

notes.title: Update 0.2.1

tags.bug: - correct operation of the store, details, receipt of vehicle;
- fixed work of bots, now the battles will be more dynamic;

tags.feature: - a simplified game mode appeared in the graphics settings of the game (mobile version of the game, only with PC control). This mode is globally optimized and simplified;
- in the hangar you can see the "Manual" for controlling vehicle in the game;
- there was a warning that the fuel is running out and there is no ammunition.
